cashBoundary: Additional provider spending remains capped at EUR 0; prepaid allocation is a separate accounting value.
humanLimits: Both independent reviewer role fees/time remain unknown until the human addendum. User active-work intervals are measured separately from provider session/wall time.
pendingInputs: actual per-host subscription fee in EUR and billing-period dates
verified nonoverlapping setup/108-attempt intervals and receipt hashes
rule: For each registered host, allocate its actual subscription-period EUR fee multiplied by the sum of measured active setup/attempt session seconds, divided by that subscription period duration in seconds. Count each interval once; never substitute missing fee, period, interval or receipt as zero. Record other subscription uses and this convention as interpretation limits.
